title: Emergent specialization from participation dynamics and multi-learner retraining

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical modeling and synthetic simulations tracking the trajectory of average predictive risk (loss) for arbitrary subpopulations as they dynamically choose among multiple machine learning models based on performance, leading to market segmentation.

Evaluating predictive risk (prediction error for commute times) disparities across six racial subpopulations using a modified ACS Travel Time prediction task derived from 2018 California Census data to empirically simulate participation dynamics.
